tools.name: curated-sbom
tools.notes: Hand-curated CycloneDX SBOM. Component versions are traced to committed source: STM32Cube FW_F0 pack from lifu-console-fw.ioc; STM32F0xx HAL from stm32f0xx_hal.c version macros; CMSIS from cmsis_version.h / stm32f0xx.h; LwRB from Core/Src/lwrb.c; jsmn from its copyright header (the library publishes no version macro, so no version is asserted). The USB Device Library headers in this tree carry no internal version macros, so that component is pinned to the STM32Cube FW_F0 V1.11.6 pack that delivers them.

component.name: openlifu-console-fw
component.description: Openwater LIFU console application firmware for STM32F072 (Console Power PCB): HV supply control and calibration, fan/temperature/RGB peripherals, JSON command interface over USB CDC and UART, DFU-mode jump to the SBSFU bootloader.

properties.name: openwater:version-source
properties.value: git describe (injected at build time as FW_VERSION)

components.name: STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32F0 (FW_F0)
components.description: STM32Cube firmware package delivering the STM32F0 HAL/LL drivers, CMSIS device files, and ST middleware used by this project.

components.name: STM32F0xx HAL Driver
components.description: Hardware abstraction layer drivers for STM32F0.

components.name: CMSIS Core (Cortex-M)
components.description: Cortex Microcontroller Software Interface Standard core headers.

components.name: CMSIS Device STM32F0xx
components.description: CMSIS device support (headers, startup, system) for STM32F0xx.

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library
components.description: ST USB device core plus CDC (virtual COM port) class, used for the JSON command interface. Version pinned to the STM32Cube FW_F0 pack (internal library version macros are not present in the committed headers).
